company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.

Supabase is a Postgres development platform that provides a suite of tools for building scalable and secure applications. It offers a dedicated Postgres database, authentication, data APIs, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings. Supabase aims to help developers build applications quickly and efficiently, with a focus on ease of use and scalability.

Vapi is a company that provides a platform for building advanced voice AI agents. It offers a unified platform for all voice agents, with orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade configurability. The platform allows users to build, test, and deploy voice agents in minutes, and track what's working across every call to continuously improve the experiences that drive their business forward.
target_audience_icp: Enterprises and businesses that require advanced voice AI solutions
